baseline.measurement: compact UTF-8 JSON bytes and indented JSON lines

stale_or_recovery.first_line_reason: Only blockers that change safe continuation remain in continuation_view.

module_rich.finding: Installed capabilities and Memory detail do not become peer continuation authorities.

projection_disposition.canonical_owner_rule: Summary remains a lossy projection; Planning/current-work sources remain durable owners.

handoff_cost.reason: A second agent receives owner, revision, intent, next action, proof freshness, claim boundary, and residue from one continuation_view without chat or raw Planning reconstruction.

shared_invariants: default guidance needs no unconditional follow-up

phase_specific.proof: complete evidence set and receipt sufficiency

cross_surface_review.abstraction_decision: Do not create a universal lifecycle envelope; the proven invariants are vocabulary-level and each phase retains its existing authority and compiler.
